destination.title: Black-hole horizons, singularities and physical viability
destination.question: Under which model-specific conditions do black holes form, retain horizons and predictability, remain dynamically viable, or require alternative descriptions?
destination.summary: A navigation family spanning classical collapse, instability, censorship, stationary solution spaces, interior regularity, quantum-gravity diagnostics and observational alternatives. Shared vocabulary does not establish common premises or question identity.

systems: Black holes, black strings and branes in the supplied dimensions and asymptotics
Collapsing matter and candidate compact objects
Specified effective, modified-gravity and holographic models
targets: Exterior visibility and weak cosmic censorship
Inner-horizon evolution and strong cosmic censorship
Horizon existence, regularity and dynamical viability
Extremality, decay, entropy and effective-theory diagnostics
regimes: Classical, semiclassical and proposed effective quantum descriptions remain distinct
Stationary, linearized and nonlinear evolution questions remain distinct
Dimensions, boundary conditions and asymptotics are source-specific
assumptions: Numerical membership is candidate provenance, not a scientific premise
Conjectures and diagnostic criteria retain their conditional status
conventions: Weak, strong and topological censorship are not interchangeable
Event, apparent, trapping and Cauchy horizons retain their source-specific meanings
Charge normalization and extremality criteria are model-specific
includes: Counterexamples, proposed repairs and limitations of censorship arguments
Methodological and observational connections with explicit contribution roles
excludes: A universal implication from the WGC to either censorship conjecture
Equating stationary horizon roots with a dynamical censorship theorem
Treating regular background construction as demonstrated formation or stability
Treating all auxiliary black-hole applications as core censorship questions

sources.title: The Causal structure of dynamical charged black holes

evidence.text: Determine the causal structure of charged black holes undergoing formation, Hawking evaporation and neutralization; assess inner-horizon stability and penetrability, and implications for cosmic censorship and black hole complementarity.

sources.title: Massless black holes and charged wormholes in string theory

evidence.text: Can special integration constants of the dyonic Einstein–Maxwell–dilaton solution produce individual zero-ADM-mass objects and a static charged Einstein–Rosen bridge, and what field pathologies and energy-condition qualifications accompany them?

sources.title: Violation of Weak Cosmic Censorship in Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton theory: singularities connected by traversable wormholes

evidence.text: Can analytic Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton solutions furnish positive-mass naked singularities, singularity pairs with a traversable connection, and a nonsingular dyonic limit? What charges, weak-gravity diagnostic and light deflection follow?

sources.title: Properties of a recent quantum extension of the Kruskal geometry

evidence.text: For a previously proposed LQG-inspired effective extension of Schwarzschild–Kruskal spacetime, are the horizon temperature, interior–exterior matching, asymptotic geometry and energy definitions physically satisfactory despite unusual curvature falloff?

sources.title: Space–time singularities and cosmic censorship conjecture: A Review with some thoughts

evidence.text: Which physical processes threaten weak or strong cosmic censorship, how should generic initial conditions be defined, and can semiclassical or quantum effects preserve predictability?

sources.title: Constraints on Low-Energy Effective Theories from Weak Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: Can weak cosmic censorship constrain higher-derivative Einstein-Maxwell EFT coefficients through attempts to overcharge an initially extremal, nonrotating black hole with infalling charged matter?

sources.title: Constraints on high-order gravitational theories from weak cosmic censorship

evidence.text: Can imposing weak cosmic censorship as a classical admissibility principle constrain higher-curvature gravitational theories, using first-order accretion experiments and a condition computable from extremal near-horizon data?

sources.title: Scalar lumps with a horizon

evidence.text: Which spherically symmetric Einstein–scalar configurations have a regular origin surrounded by a horizon, and what additional geometries appear when the areal radius is allowed to turn around?

sources.title: Scalar lumps with two horizons

evidence.text: What global geometries and existence limits arise for static, spherically symmetric scalar lumps with two horizons, and can their Euclidean continuations be smoothly attached to an exterior vacuum spacetime for black hole seeded decay?

sources.title: Exploration of a singular fluid spacetime

evidence.text: What singularity, perturbation, tidal-response and geodesic properties characterize relativistic singular isothermal spheres, and can their Einstein–dilaton realization connect naked singularities to the swampland distance conjecture?

sources.title: Planar black holes as a route to understanding the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can extremal or near-extremal black-hole decay satisfy the second law, and what mechanism causes instability? The paper studies these questions for five-dimensional charged black holes, emphasizing AdS solutions with flat toroidal or planar transverse sections.

sources.title: Penrose Inequality as a Constraint on the Low Energy Limit of Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Can BF-allowed tachyonic scalar matter violate the AdS Penrose inequality while preserving the null energy condition?

sources.title: Interiors of singularity-free rotating black holes

evidence.text: Within the Gürses–Gürsey class of regular rotating metrics, when can observers cross the disk or ring without introducing negative-r regions, and what follows for curvature regularity, effective matter, causality and global structure?

sources.title: Black Holes Inside and Out 2024: visions for the future of black hole physics

evidence.text: What theoretical developments and observations can clarify black hole stability, horizon structure, quantum evaporation, and departures from general relativity?

sources.title: Analyzing WGC and WCCC through charged scalar fields fluxes with charged AdS black holes surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter in the CFT thermodynamics

evidence.text: Can charged-scalar absorption and superradiant emission preserve weak cosmic censorship while supporting the weak gravity conjecture for RN–AdS black holes surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter, within holographic CFT thermodynamics?

sources.title: Regular black holes without mass-inflation instability and gravastars from modified gravity

evidence.text: Can a specified four-dimensional gravitational action admit regular, nonspinning black holes that become extremal for every mass-to-coupling ratio, thereby avoiding the stated mass-inflation mechanism? Can the same framework produce gravastar-like objects?

sources.title: Tachyon condensation and black strings

evidence.text: Can winding-tachyon condensation outside a charged black-string horizon replace the horizon with a charged Kaluza-Klein bubble before string-scale curvature is reached, and when is the resulting bubble static or expanding?

sources.title: Gravitational collapse: The role of general relativity

evidence.text: Which features of relativistic stellar collapse survive departures from spherical symmetry: horizons, singularities, a predictable exterior endpoint and extractable energy? Can collapse from reasonable nonsingular initial conditions instead produce a visible singularity?

sources.title: The Causal structure of dynamical charged black holes

evidence.text: The authors report second-order convergence under successive factor-two refinements, errors approximately at or below 0.1%, and disagreement between integration schemes approximately at or below 1%. Rapid variation near the outer horizon produces error spikes.

sources.title: Massless black holes and charged wormholes in string theory

evidence.text: Impose d1=−d0=−Σ and r1=−r2=rH. The author obtains M=0, e^(2φ0)=±P/Q and rH²=Σ²∓2QP, with opposite correlated signs, and states that the remaining algebraic equations of motion are satisfied.

sources.title: Violation of Weak Cosmic Censorship in Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton theory: singularities connected by traversable wormholes

evidence.text: Closed-form radial solutions are examined through curvature divergences, the equation e^(-λ)=0, and radial null travel times involving ∫e^λdr. These are the paper's diagnostics for singularities and absence of horizons.

sources.title: Properties of a recent quantum extension of the Kruskal geometry

evidence.text: Simplify the exterior metric using small quantum parameters, introduce a solution-dependent rescaled time τ, and examine metric and curvature falloff. Evaluate separate energy surface integrals using the spatial metric and spatial Ricci tensor, with lapse adapted to the exact Killing field.

sources.title: Space–time singularities and cosmic censorship conjecture: A Review with some thoughts

evidence.text: Reviews attempts to destroy horizons through charged or spinning test bodies, test fields and matter shells. Effective potentials, self-force or backreaction, and formation of a larger shielding horizon can change conclusions drawn from simpler approximations.

sources.title: Constraints on Low-Energy Effective Theories from Weak Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: For the general extension, take the extremal limit of the black-hole first law to identify (dM/dQ)ext=ΦH. The authors then compare this slope with the same NEC crossing inequality.

sources.title: Weak cosmic censorship with excited scalar fields and bound on charge-to-mass ratio

evidence.text: Do first- and second-excited charged scalar fields remove the electrically driven AdS counterexamples to weak cosmic censorship, and is there a minimum scalar charge protecting regularity?

sources.title: Black Strings, Low Viscosity Fluids, and Violation of Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: What is the nonlinear endpoint of the Gregory–Laflamme instability of a five-dimensional black string, and can its horizon develop arbitrarily large curvature visible to exterior observers in finite asymptotic time?

sources.title: Predictivity lost, predictivity regained: a Miltonian cosmic censorship conjecture

evidence.text: Can weak cosmic censorship be amended to accommodate controlled naked-curvature examples while preserving useful classical predictivity and allowing only minimal exposure of Planck-scale physics?

sources.title: Charged black holes in Einsteinian cubic gravity and nonuniqueness

evidence.text: Can four-dimensional Einsteinian cubic gravity minimally coupled to Maxwell electrodynamics support distinct asymptotically flat black holes with identical mass and charge, and how do their horizons, thermodynamics and horizonless counterparts behave?

sources.title: Attempts at vacuum counterexamples to cosmic censorship in AdS

evidence.text: Can boundary differential rotation produce vacuum AdS4 counterexamples to weak cosmic censorship by driving stationary solutions beyond a finite rotation amplitude, and what role do boundary ergoregions play?

sources.title: Compact objects and the swampland

evidence.text: Can a rotating black hole remain in equilibrium with an exterior scalar condensate? The imported construction uses synchronized rotation and connects solitonic rotating stars to a restricted Kerr scalar-cloud boundary.

sources.title: The weak gravity conjecture, overcharged shells and gravitational traps

evidence.text: Can classical Einstein–Maxwell theory admit extended spherical objects with gravitational mass m<|Q|, and can their evolution avoid naked singularities while supporting trapped gravitational perturbations?

sources.title: Black hole mimickers: from theory to observation

evidence.text: Which physically consistent, long-lived horizonless objects can reproduce black-hole observations, and which gravitational-wave or electromagnetic signatures could distinguish them?

sources.title: Classical and thermodynamic stability of black branes

evidence.text: Under what assumptions does local thermodynamic instability imply a classical Gregory–Laflamme instability, and conversely, for black branes with noncompact translational symmetry? Does the instability disappear in a finite neighborhood of extremality?

sources.title: Gravitational collapse and cosmic censorship

evidence.text: Does gravitational collapse from nonsingular, asymptotically flat initial data generically keep singularities and their effects inaccessible to distant observers? This review addresses weak cosmic censorship, rather than strong cosmic censorship.

sources.title: Black strings and p-branes are unstable

evidence.text: Are extended, uncharged black strings and p-branes linearly stable under small gravitational perturbations, and what might an exterior instability imply for compactification and cosmic censorship?

sources.title: The weak gravity conjecture requires the existence of exotic AdS black holes

evidence.text: If a classically extremal AdS4–Kerr–Newman black hole stable against superradiance decays through smaller black holes, what restrictions follow for the daughters' specific angular momenta, horizons and compatibility with classical Cosmic Censorship?

sources.title: Further evidence for the weak gravity — cosmic censorship connection

evidence.text: Does charged matter satisfying the appropriately modified weak gravity bound remove the boundary-driven AdS counterexamples to weak cosmic censorship when a dilaton or a second Maxwell field is added, and is that bound necessary?

sources.title: Stringy black holes and energy conditions

evidence.text: Which dilaton and dilaton–Maxwell black holes satisfy local or averaged energy conditions, in which domains and frames, and what does this establish about geodesic focusing and the applicability of singularity theorems?

sources.title: A Semiclassical, Entropic Proof of a Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can the generalized second law distinguish a consistent charged-scalar theory from an inconsistent one using only its macroscopic fields on a semiclassical black-hole background?

sources.title: Young Black Holes Have Smooth Horizons: A Swampland Argument

evidence.text: Can the swampland distance bound provide evidence for smooth young black-hole horizons by locating large modulus excursions relative to the apparent horizon and curvature singularity during collapse?

sources.title: Obstructions to minimal regular black hole cosmologies

evidence.text: Can a static, asymptotically flat regular black hole support a minimal FLRW daughter that expands without bound while remaining curvature regular, geodesically complete, and consistent with the averaged null energy condition?

sources.title: Instabilities of the Small Black Hole: A View from N=4 SYM

evidence.text: Can weakly coupled thermal N=4 SYM reveal a counterpart of the Gregory–Laflamme localization instability of the small AdS5 black hole smeared on S5, through R-charged unstable directions and symmetry-breaking saddles?

sources.title: Final state of Gregory–Laflamme instability

evidence.text: What is the nonlinear endpoint of the Gregory–Laflamme instability of a five-dimensional vacuum black string, and does its evolution imply a naked singularity in finite time measured by asymptotic observers?

sources.title: Regular Black Hole Interior Spacetime Supported by Three-Form Field

evidence.text: Does the reconstructed regular interior survive inhomogeneous perturbations and arise from gravitational collapse without producing a different singularity? These questions determine whether the background construction can describe a dynamically realized black hole.

sources.title: Entropy and mass bounds of Kerr-de Sitter spacetimes

evidence.text: How does rotation affect Kerr–de Sitter boundary mass, angular momentum, cosmological-horizon entropy and the c-function? Does this family respect the N-bound and maximal mass conjecture, and can boundary mass diagnose the absence of cosmological singularities?

sources.title: Cosmic Censorship of Trans-Planckian Field Ranges in Gravitational Collapse

evidence.text: What scalar-field excursions arise dynamically during gravitational collapse, and are order-one Planck-unit excursions hidden behind horizons? This reverses the heuristic argument that sufficiently large spatial field variations themselves cause black-hole formation.

sources.title: The characteristic initial-boundary value problem for the Einstein--massless Vlasov system in spherical symmetry

evidence.text: Establish characteristic well-posedness, continuation criteria and low-regularity finite-time Cauchy stability of AdS for the spherically symmetric Einstein–massless Vlasov system with reflecting conformal infinity.

sources.title: WGC and WCCC of black holes with quintessence and cloud strings in RPS space

evidence.text: Can RN-AdS black holes surrounded by quintessence and a string cloud satisfy the paper's weak-gravity charge-to-mass criterion while retaining a horizon at a restricted-phase-space thermodynamic critical point?

sources.title: A proof of the instability of AdS for the Einstein-massless Vlasov system

evidence.text: Can arbitrarily small, smooth, spherically symmetric perturbations of AdS develop trapped spheres under Einstein–massless Vlasov evolution with reflecting conformal infinity, without an inner mirror?

sources.title: Regular Black Hole Interior Spacetime Supported by Three-Form Field

evidence.text: The Kantowski–Sachs representation makes a spherical black-hole interior an anisotropic cosmology: the longitudinal scale factor and sphere radius evolve with proper time. Schwarzschild then provides a precise horizon limit against which regular interiors can be compared.

sources.title: Noncommutativity and the Weak Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: Can a massless noncommutative scalar probe dress an AdS3 naked singularity with a BTZ horizon, consistently with weak cosmic censorship, and yield a quantum-complete effective spacetime?

sources.title: Weak cosmic censorship with self-interacting scalar and bound on charge to mass ratio

evidence.text: How do quartic and hexic scalar self-interactions change the minimum scalar charge required to remove a previously identified class of weak cosmic censorship counterexamples in asymptotically AdS Einstein-Maxwell theory?

sources.title: Horizonless black hole mimickers with spin

evidence.text: Can a rotating horizonless black shell be constructed with a physically motivated surface stress tensor, and what exterior multipoles, fluid flows, and stability properties distinguish this model from Kerr?

sources.title: Testing the Weak Gravity - Cosmic Censorship Connection

evidence.text: Does adding a sufficiently charged scalar remove the proposed electrically driven AdS4 counterexamples to weak cosmic censorship, and does the minimum charge needed for regular endpoints coincide with the proposed AdS weak-gravity bound?

sources.title: A Semiclassical, Entropic Proof of a Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: The background permits a semiclassical test of a charged scalar whose mass is too large to discharge an extremal black hole along a chosen charge direction. A large radius suppresses curvature while the charge projection q·Q can remain large.

sources.title: End Point of the Ultraspinning Instability and Violation of Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: What is the nonlinear endpoint of the axisymmetric ultraspinning instability of six-dimensional Myers–Perry black holes, and does its evolution provide evidence for a violation of weak cosmic censorship?

sources.title: Stringy forces in the black hole interior

evidence.text: Assuming effective field theory is valid at a macroscopic outer horizon, where inside the black hole do string-sized tidal curvature, compactification scales or Planckian curvature invalidate that description?

sources.title: Short-hair black holes and the strong cosmic censorship conjecture

evidence.text: Do short-hair black holes satisfy strong cosmic censorship under neutral massless or charged massive scalar perturbations, particularly near extremality, and how do Q/Qmax, the metric parameter k and angular number ℓ affect the paper’s decay-versus-blueshift diagnostic?

sources.title: The Einstein--null dust system in spherical symmetry with an inner mirror: structure of the maximal development and Cauchy stability

evidence.text: Does an inner reflecting mirror restore well-posedness for spherical Einstein–null dust with AdS asymptotics, and can Cauchy stability be controlled uniformly as the mirror radius shrinks?

sources.title: Comments on cosmic censorship in AdS / CFT

evidence.text: Can HHM-type scalar initial data force weak cosmic-censorship violation through insufficient conserved energy to cloak the collapsing region, while retaining a well-behaved dual field theory?

sources.title: A Short Review of Time Dependent Solutions and Space-like Singularities in String Theory

evidence.text: Can a black-hole interior isolate the effects of a spacelike singularity from strong local curvature? The BTZ quotient supplies such a laboratory because its local curvature is inherited from AdS3, while its global geometry has a horizon and singularity.

sources.title: A Note on the Swampland Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: Can a black hole be resolved within the effective theory while remaining inside the cosmic horizon? The paper requires a common radius interval between the species cutoff length and H^(-1).

sources.title: Strong cosmic censorship in light of weak gravity conjecture for charged black holes

evidence.text: Can the electric weak gravity conjecture ensure strong cosmic censorship for charged de Sitter black holes perturbed by a massive charged scalar, as diagnosed through quasinormal decay relative to Cauchy-horizon blueshift?

sources.title: Null Fluid Collapse in Rastall Theory of Gravity

evidence.text: Under what conditions does spherical null-fluid collapse in Rastall gravity produce physically admissible, strong-curvature naked singularities, and when are they locally or globally visible?

sources.title: Black holes and wormholes in (2+1)-dimensions

evidence.text: Which black-hole spacetimes arise from discrete AdS3 identifications with time-symmetric initial data and one asymptotic region, and how do interior topology, horizon formation, trapped curves and topological censorship behave?

sources.title: Breaking an Abelian gauge symmetry near a black hole horizon

evidence.text: Can a minimally coupled charged scalar develop a condensate slightly outside a sufficiently cold, electrically charged AdS4 black hole, even with positive scalar mass squared, suggesting superconducting behavior?

sources.title: Evidence for an Electrifying Violation of Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: Can localized electric boundary forcing in four-dimensional asymptotically AdS Einstein–Maxwell theory drive smooth initial data toward arbitrarily large curvature visible to distant observers, providing a counterexample to the version of cosmic censorship considered here?

sources.title: Improved effective dynamics of loop-quantum-gravity black hole and Nariai limit

evidence.text: Can a reduced-phase-space, μ̄-scheme effective model describe both black-hole interior and exterior, resolve the Schwarzschild singularity, and determine the late-time geometry and its stability?

sources.title: End Point of Black Ring Instabilities and the Weak Cosmic Censorship Conjecture

evidence.text: What are the nonlinear endpoints of black-ring instabilities, and can sufficiently thin rings provide evidence for weak cosmic censorship violation in asymptotically flat five-dimensional gravity?

sources.title: Quantum censors: Backreaction builds horizons

evidence.text: Can quantum matter backreaction protect weak cosmic censorship whenever a reliable semiclassical spacetime description exists, and can quantum Penrose inequalities test this beyond perturbatively weak backreaction?

sources.title: Holography abhors visible trapped surfaces

evidence.text: Does consistency of the classical holographic dictionary force trapped surfaces behind event horizons, establishing this consequence of weak cosmic censorship without assuming the full initial-data conjecture?

sources.title: The Averaged Null Energy Condition and the Black Hole Interior in String Theory

evidence.text: Can spontaneously created folded strings produce macroscopic ANEC violation at weak coupling and small curvature, and could their backreaction change the black-hole interior and information flow?

sources.title: Cosmic-quantum connections: Assessing the viability of weak gravity and weak cosmic censorship conjectures in Kerr-Newman-Kiselev-Letelier black hole

evidence.text: Can spin, a string cloud, and a quintessence term permit horizon-bearing extremal Kerr–Newman–Kiselev–Letelier configurations with Q²/M²>1, which the authors interpret as compatible with both the mild weak gravity conjecture and weak cosmic censorship?

sources.title: Weak cosmic censorship with SU(2) gauge field and bound on charge-to-mass ratio

evidence.text: Does adding a charged azimuthal component of an SU(2) gauge field remove a known class of AdS weak-cosmic-censorship counterexamples, and is there a minimum charge sufficient to obtain regular solutions at large boundary electric amplitude?

sources.title: Regular Black Hole Interior Spacetime Supported by Three-Form Field

evidence.text: Can a classical three-form regularize a black-hole interior while leaving its low-curvature, near-horizon geometry approximately Schwarzschild? The target is an interior without the vanishing sphere radius and finite-time singularity of the vacuum solution.

sources.title: dS$_{4}$ universe emergent from Kerr-AdS$_{5}$ spacetime: bubble nucleation catalyzed by a black hole

evidence.text: Can a vacuum bubble nucleated around a rotating AdS5 black hole support quasi-dS4 cosmology, and how do rotation, black-hole regularity and competing superradiance constrain nucleation and its rate?

sources.title: A proof of the instability of AdS for the Einstein--null dust system with an inner mirror

evidence.text: Can arbitrarily small, Cauchy-stable perturbations of AdS develop trapped surfaces through repeated reflections, in the spherically symmetric Einstein–null dust model with a shrinking inner mirror?

sources.title: Cosmic censorship for AdS5-Kerr

evidence.text: Does cosmic censorship exclude physically problematic five-dimensional AdS–Kerr geometries, and can superradiance, brane nucleation, or an additional holographic mass bound eliminate the remaining large-specific-angular-momentum cases?

sources.title: The fate of horizons under quantum corrections

evidence.text: How does the Goroff–Sagnotti Weyl-cube deformation change spherical vacuum geometries, Schwarzschild horizons and their structural stability?

sources.title: Gravitational Instabilities and Censorship of Large Scalar Field Excursions

evidence.text: Can localized transplanckian scalar excursions evade gravitational censorship through smooth higher-dimensional completion, and do classical instabilities supply an alternative censorship mechanism?

sources.title: Holographic Dual of The Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: What constraints do cosmic censorship and its proposed WGC modification impose holographically on boundary matter, especially the number of colours Nc, and could these constraints obstruct realistic QCD models?

sources.title: Yang-Mills field modified RN black hole and the Strong Cosmic Censorship Conjecture

evidence.text: Does a nonlinear Yang–Mills modification of a charged RN black hole change the scalar-perturbation diagnostic for strong cosmic censorship, and under what charged-scalar conditions can an extremal modified black hole satisfy that diagnostic?

sources.title: Gravitational Waves from Black Hole Emission

evidence.text: What plausible gravitational-wave morphology would accompany emission of a small black hole by a larger one, with or without subsequent reabsorption, and can simple modifications of existing waveforms provide templates for future null tests of GR?

sources.title: The Weak Gravity Conjecture and the Axionic Black Hole Paradox

evidence.text: Can a perturbatively massless 2-form have parametrically small coupling f without light charged strings or a low cutoff? The paper seeks a physical obstruction from axionic black-hole evaporation rather than assumptions about extremal black strings or gravitational instantons.

sources.title: Black hole production in particle collisions and higher curvature gravity

evidence.text: Can classical Einstein gravity and the closed trapped surface argument reliably justify the geometric black-hole production cross section σ ∼ πRSchw(E)² in transplanckian particle collisions when collision-induced curvature and higher-curvature corrections are considered?

sources.title: Charged perfect fluids in the presence of a cosmological constant

evidence.text: Which exact static, spherically symmetric charged-fluid solutions exist with a cosmological constant, what compactness restrictions follow within the chosen family, and which electrovac exteriors or closed two-center configurations do they require?

sources.title: Horizons cannot save the Landscape

evidence.text: Can the divergent three-form energy density associated with anti-D3 backreaction be cloaked by a regular event horizon? The proposed diagnostic is whether asymptotically KT or mass-deformed KS black holes can carry horizon Maxwell D3 charge opposite to their positive asymptotic charge.

sources.title: Violating the Weak Cosmic Censorship Conjecture in Four-Dimensional Anti–de Sitter Space

evidence.text: Can initially pure four-dimensional AdS, driven by a localized boundary electric field, develop arbitrarily large curvature visible to boundary observers, violating the version of weak cosmic censorship considered here?

sources.title: Compact objects and the swampland

evidence.text: Do conjectural quantum-gravity bounds distinguish stable scalar compact objects from unstable or ultracompact configurations? The paper tests spherical and rotating boson stars and synchronized hairy black holes, using light rings as the operational sign of ultracompactness.

sources.title: Weak cosmic censorship in Born–Infeld electrodynamics and bound on charge-to-mass ratio

evidence.text: Do boundary-driven Einstein–Born–Infeld solutions in AdS provide counterexamples to weak cosmic censorship, and can a sufficiently charged scalar remove them? How do the inferred charge thresholds depend on the Born–Infeld parameter?

sources.title: First order description of black holes in moduli space

evidence.text: Choose a charge normal form, differentiate a linear combination of its magnitudes, and match all quadratic terms to the known charge potential. Quotient equivalent coefficient choices and retain those with the required horizon critical point.

sources.title: Fake supersymmetry versus Hamilton-Jacobi

evidence.text: Compare the HJ rewriting of the action as sums and differences of squares with the usual fake-superpotential rewriting. Factorization ℳW=e^(aU)W(φ) reproduces both the standard scalar/warp-factor flows and the defining potential relation for W.

sources.title: Flow Equations for Non-BPS Extremal Black Holes

evidence.text: Treat the potential decomposition as a PDE for W. After rescaling by e^U, seek gradient vectors of equal norm related by metric-preserving rotations R; the rotated one-form must be locally closed to define another superpotential.

sources.title: First order description of black holes in moduli space

evidence.text: The authors vary an off-shell extension of an on-shell identity to restore compatibility with their scalar flow. This procedure depends on derivative conventions and must be checked against the original fixed-charge potential, rather than treating on-shell equality as sufficient.

sources.title: First order description of black holes in moduli space

evidence.text: Factor V_BH into W²+2‖dW‖², then integrate the scalar gradient flow and the warp equation. Covariant differentiation verifies the scalar acceleration, while the same identity verifies the warp equation and zero-energy constraint.

sources.title: Fake supersymmetry versus Hamilton-Jacobi

evidence.text: Introduce configuration variables qᵃ=(U,φⁱ), canonical momenta and Hamilton’s characteristic function ℳW. The HJ construction gives S=ℳW−2c²τ and gradient velocities q̇ᵃ=Gᵃᵇ∂ᵦℳW; local existence is invoked as a standard mechanics theorem.
